prompt:

Represent cool airflow ONLY with THREE SHORT DARK BROWN CURVED STROKES between vent and woman. No blue ribbons, no white streaks, no mist, no blur, no haze. Complete compact composition.
Use attached invidious.png for drawing style only: thick rounded dark brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D forms. All silhouettes clean closed dark brown outlines. 512x512 PNG RGBA.
